en_title: Mob Entertainment Lays Off 'Almost Entire' Escape From Playtime Team
cn_title: Mob Entertainment裁撤《Escape From Playtime》「几乎整个」团队
opus_summary: Mob Entertainment一名前首席游戏设计师称，《Escape From Playtime》项目几乎所有员工都已遭裁，包括其本人。该游戏于2026年10月21日推出。社区经理表示，游戏开发将继续，团队已根据玩家反馈调整路线图，计划改进匹配机制和现有地图等内容。

paragraphs.en: A former member of Mob Entertainment’s Escape from Playtime Team claims “almost all” staff working on the project have been laid off.
paragraphs.cn: Mob Entertainment旗下《Escape From Playtime》团队的一名前成员称，参与该项目的「几乎所有」员工都已被裁。

paragraphs.en: The news comes from a LinkedIn post penned by a former lead game designer at the studio on November 4, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 这一消息来自该工作室一名前首席游戏设计师于2026年11月4日在LinkedIn上发布的帖子。

paragraphs.en: “Today is a tough day,” they wrote. “Mob has laid off almost the entire Escape From Playtime team, including myself. If anyone knows of any work that I or any of the team affected can do, please reach out. This industry is tough, but the people band together to help each other out. Today that help is needed.
paragraphs.cn: 「今天是艰难的一天，」他们写道，「Mob裁掉了《Escape From Playtime》团队几乎所有人，包括我自己。如果有人知道任何适合我或其他受影响团队成员的工作，请联系我。这个行业很艰难，但人们会团结起来互相帮助。今天，我们需要这样的帮助。

paragraphs.en: “For my friends affected at Mob I'm sorry, we did an amazing job, and pushed out a fantastic game. Be proud of what we accomplished. For those at Mob not affected, I will miss you all. Thank you for the opportunity to make EFP. Back to the grind.”
paragraphs.cn: 「对于我在Mob受到影响的朋友们，我很抱歉，我们做得非常出色，推出了一款很棒的游戏。为我们的成就感到骄傲吧。对于Mob没有受到影响的各位，我会想念你们所有人。感谢你们给我制作《EFP》的机会。继续努力。」

paragraphs.en: Escape From Playtime is an online survival co-op game for two to eight players based on the horror mascot Poppy Playtime franchise. In the game, teams play as Smiling Critters plushes as they scavenge for resources and avoid monstrous mascot monsters. The spinoff was released on October 21, 2026; with so many staff being laid off just two weeks later, fans understandably grew worried about the game’s future.
paragraphs.cn: 《Escape From Playtime》是一款基于恐怖吉祥物系列《Poppy Playtime》制作的2至8人在线生存合作游戏。在游戏中，玩家组队扮演Smiling Critters毛绒玩偶，搜寻资源并躲避可怕的吉祥物怪物。这款衍生游戏于2026年10月21日发售；仅仅两周后就有这么多员工被裁，粉丝们对游戏的未来感到担忧也是可以理解的。

paragraphs.en: Luckily, it has been confirmed that Escape From Playtime is still sticking around — at least, for now. On the game’s official Discord channel, Mob Entertainment's community manager Tyler Scott Sanchez spoke out about the layoffs and vaguely hinted at what’s next for the game. Sanchez said that development on the title will continue, outlining several improvements that are planned based on players’ feedback thus far.
paragraphs.cn: 幸运的是，《Escape From Playtime》已被确认会继续运营——至少目前如此。在游戏的官方Discord频道上，Mob Entertainment社区经理Tyler Scott Sanchez谈到了此次裁员，并含糊地暗示了游戏接下来的计划。Sanchez表示，游戏开发将继续，并概述了根据玩家迄今为止的反馈而计划进行的几项改进。

paragraphs.en: “We've had to make the incredibly tough decision to part ways with some talented members of our team who helped bring Escape From Playtime to life. These are people who poured their creativity and passion into building this game and making it something special. We're incredibly grateful for everything they've contributed, and we want to take a moment to recognize the people behind the work. This isn't the kind of news we ever want to share, and we know it's difficult to hear, especially for a community that cares so deeply about the game and the people who make it,” he wrote.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们不得不做出一个极其艰难的决定，与团队中一些才华横溢的成员分别，他们曾帮助《Escape From Playtime》问世。这些人在制作这款游戏时倾注了创意和热情，让它变得与众不同。我们非常感谢他们的所有贡献，也希望借此机会向这些工作背后的人们致意。这并不是我们愿意分享的消息，我们知道这很难让人接受，尤其是对于一个如此关心这款游戏及其制作者的社区来说，」他写道。

paragraphs.en: “We also know that this will carry uncertainty from many of you about the future of Escape From Playtime. To be clear, development on the game continues. We've already made changes to the roadmap based on your feedback, including improvements to matchmaking, the order in which we'll roll out bigger body enemies, making the existing map more diverse and interesting, and much more.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们也知道，这会让你们中的许多人对《Escape From Playtime》的未来感到不确定。明确地说，游戏的开发将继续。我们已经根据你们的反馈调整了开发路线图，包括改进匹配机制、调整推出体型更大敌人的顺序、让现有地图更加多样和有趣，以及更多内容。

paragraphs.en: “We know that news like this can bring a lot of questions, and it's important to us that we're transparent about where things stand. While we don't have every answer to share just yet, we'll continue to communicate the development process with you all.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们知道这样的消息可能引发许多疑问，对我们来说，坦诚说明目前的情况很重要。虽然我们现在还无法回答所有问题，但我们会继续与大家沟通开发进程。」
